events.title: Update 0.43.2: full casks and a plain E and Q
events.summary: Two lessons that could not be finished can be finished now, and E and Q each do one job. E does something to what you look at. Q opens its card. Changed E always does something to what you look at, and Q always opens its card. E with empty hands on a barrel, a bin, a chest or the wagon no longer opens the card. Press Q to look inside. The crosshair tip shows the name on one line and the key on the next. It names what E will do: talk, give, lead, settle, feed, take, put it in, manage, open, shut,

events.title: Update 0.34.0: casks, crucibles and cleaner panels
events.summary: Wine stays in the cask until someone brings a bucket, alloys move out of the smelter into a crucible, and the panels stop cramming three facts into one line. Seven playtest findings ride along: the selected tool shows its name, the tunnel popup lines up, a stockpile or zone paint waits for OK, the sowing window groups crops by kind, the card title sits over its body, and a picker opens above the panel that called it.
